{'text': 'iPadOS 27.2 嘅 beta 版本將於本週推出，除咗重新設計嘅 Health App 之外，Apple 亦將一個近期 Mac 先有嘅功能帶到 iPad：揀選文字時彈出 Siri 視窗。', 'target': 'The beta of iPadOS 27.2 will arrive later this week, and in addition to a redesigned Health app, Apple is bringing another recently Mac-only feature to iPad: a pop-up Siri window when you select text.'}

{'text': 'iPadOS 27.2 加入揀字彈 Siri 功能，同 macOS Golden Gate 一樣', 'target': 'iPadOS 27.2 adds text selection Siri popup, just like macOS Golden Gate'}

{'text': 'Siri AI 係 iOS 27、iPadOS 27 以及同期作業系統嘅主要新功能，因此 Apple 提供咗多種方式去召喚呢個升級版嘅智能助理。', 'target': "Siri AI is the marquee new feature in iOS 27, iPadOS 27, and the rest of this year's operating systems, so Apple has provided multiple ways to summon the upgraded assistant."}

{'text': '喺 iPad 上，你可以用聲控講「Siri」或者「喂 Siri」嚟叫 Siri、由畫面頂部拉落、打開編輯選單入面新增嘅 Siri 選項、開個新 Siri App，或者我最鍾意嘅方法：用 CMD + Space 開 Spotlight，再喺度問 Siri 問題。', 'target': 'On iPad, you can use voice by saying "Siri" or "Hey Siri" to launch Siri, pull down from the top of the screen, open a new Siri option in the edit menu, open a new Siri app, or my favorite: use Spotlight with CMD + Space and ask Siri questions there.'}

{'text': '不過 iPadOS 27.2 再多咗一個直接由 Mac 移植過嚟嘅方法。', 'target': 'But iPadOS 27.2 adds another method that comes directly from the Mac.'}

{'text': '喺 macOS 27 Golden Gate 入面，好多情況下當你揀選一段文字，揀選範圍嘅左上角會出現一個細細嘅 Siri 圖示。當你用滑鼠移到圖示上面，佢會展開，畀你「問 Siri」嘅文字輸入框。', 'target': 'In macOS 27 Golden Gate, in many cases when you select a piece of text, a small Siri icon appears in the upper left corner of the selection. Hovering your mouse over the icon expands it into a text input field to "Ask Siri."'}

{'text': '呢個功能喺 iPadOS 27 係冇嘅。但而家，如果你將一個觸控板連去你部 iPad，就可以喺 iPadOS 27.2 用到同樣嘅效果。', 'target': 'This functionality is absent from iPadOS 27. But now, if you connect a trackpad to your iPad, you can achieve the same effect in iPadOS 27.2.'}

{'text': '如上圖所見，新嘅 Siri 圖示一開始好細，唔阻住用家，但只要將游標移上去就會即刻彈出「問 Siri」輸入框，非常方便。', 'target': 'As seen in the image above, the new Siri icon starts out small so as not to get in the way, but as soon as you hover over it with your cursor, the "Ask Siri" input field pops right up, making it very convenient.'}

{'text': '如果你冇連接觸控板，揀字嘅時候都仲會顯示完整嘅編輯選單，俾你撳入去打開 Siri。但有觸控板嘅話，成個體驗會順暢好多，亦更自然一體。', 'target': "If you don't have a trackpad connected, selecting text will still bring up the full edit menu where you can tap into Siri. But with a trackpad, the whole experience is a lot smoother and feels more natural."}

{'text': 'macOS 有好多類似嘅細微提升工作效率嘅功能，令日常操作更快捷，但偏偏喺 iPadOS 一直都冇。能夠見到啱啱推出嘅 Mac 功能咁快移植到 iPad，確實令人期待。', 'target': "There are a lot of these small efficiency-boosting features on macOS that make day-to-day use just a little quicker, but iPadOS has been missing out. It's exciting to see these new Mac features come to iPad so quickly."}

{'text': '你對 iPadOS 27.2 嘅新 Siri 彈出視窗有咩睇法？歡迎喺留言區講俾我哋聽。', 'target': 'What do you think of the new Siri popup in iPadOS 27.2? Let me know in the comments.'}
